title: MIF identity snapshot (v0)
description: Payload of an identity snapshot: a compact JWS (ES256) with header typ "mif-snapshot+jwt". It records that an upstream identity provider verified a subject live at a point in time, and it is the only thing that makes a subject eligible for continuity sign-in until it expires. See spec.md section 9.

iss.description: Logical name of the issuing MIF node. An active node and its standby use the same value and different signing keys.

sub.description: Subject identifier. Identical to the sub claim of the tokens the node issues for this subject.

jti.description: Unique identifier of this snapshot. Revocation and audit records refer to it.

iat.description: When the snapshot was signed (seconds since the epoch).

exp.description: When the snapshot stops conferring eligibility. Always verified_at plus the policy lifetime, never extended.

verified_at.description: When the upstream provider last verified the subject live. Expiry is anchored to this, not to iat.

source_idp.description: Alias of the upstream identity provider that performed the live verification.

source_sub.description: The subject's identifier at the upstream provider, when known.

assurance.description: Assurance of the live verification this snapshot records (spec.md section 11). A session later opened from the snapshot is FAL1, never this level.

roles.description: Business roles held at verification time. The restricted claim set: no profile data beyond what authorisation needs.
